description: Return a side-by-side view of two standards using only verified record fields. Pass a and b (id, acronym, or name). Returns { a, b, agentic_peers, comparison_url, license } where each side is { id, name, acronym, step, tier, lifecycle_status, question, spec_url, url, v05_identity_sentence_md, v05_problem_md, v05_infobox_rows, v05_last_checked_display }. agentic_peers are verbatim v05_counterparts.agentic_peers entries that point from one side to the other. comparison_url is the canonical /compare/ page when that slug exists, otherwise null. Use compare for a verified pair; use search if an id is unknown.

a.description: first standard id, acronym, or name

b.description: second standard id, acronym, or name

name: compare
title: Compare two standards
